# Vietnam Thermal Generation Assets Inventory (> 30 MWe)

**Scope & Methodology Notes:**
- This inventory covers thermal power plants (coal, domestic gas, imported LNG) with individual units ≥ 30 MWe, reflecting past, present, and planned assets as of late 2024.
- Statuses reflect the Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) **Power Development Plan 8 (PDP8)** approved in December 2023, which suspended/cancelled numerous coal projects and repurposed several for gas/LNG or renewable integration.
- Technology classifications follow standard industry definitions: Coal (Subcritical/Supercritical/USC), Gas/LNG (CCGT/OCGT). Vietnam has no operational USC coal units; all modern coal plants are Supercritical.
- Sources cite official government documents, utility disclosures, and international energy agency reports. URLs point to publicly accessible official repositories; document sections/tables are specified per request.
- Data is parametric (knowledge cutoff 2024). Project statuses, CODs, and ownership may evolve with financing, environmental approvals, or PDP8 implementation updates.

## Goal

Produce a complete, primary-sourced reference inventory of Vietnam's past, present and future thermal generation assets (> 30MWe) structured as follows:

## Structured power plants table

Tabulate for every thermal power plant in Vietnam:

| Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel | Technology | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | COD | Owner/Developer | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes |

Where:
- Fuel: Coal / Domestic gas / Imported LNG
- Technology (coal): Subcritical / Supercritical / USC
- Technology (gas): CCGT / OCGT
- Status: Approved / Planned / Operational / Under construction / Suspended / Cancelled / Retired
- Total MWe: Include units > 30MWe.
- COD: Actual or expected commercial operation date
- Sources: specify where in the document, include URL

Output format: Markdown.
